name: Hydroxocobalamin 10000 mcg / Thiamine 100 mg / Pyridoxine 50 mg Injectable Solution 5 Ampoules
description: The combination of hydroxocobalamin (vitamin B12), thiamine (vitamin B1), and pyridoxine (vitamin B6) is a high-potency vitamin complex used to treat deficiencies of these vitamins, neurological disorders, muscle pain, and neuralgia. The injectable presentation of 5 ampoules is common for treatments requiring a concentrated dose and rapid absorption. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
